messages.en:
{07 00 00}Speaking of which,{01 00 00 05 00}
{04 1f 00}, {01 00 00 0a 00}you're good
at bug catching, right?
{07 16 00}I heard you're very
confident about how fast
you catch bugs{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 14 00}How about this time we
compete on the rarity of
the bug instead of speed?
{07 0b 00}What do you say,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}? Wanna give it
a go?
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Kui sellest juttu tuli,{01 00 00 05 00}
{04 1f 00}, {01 00 00 0a 00}sa oled hea
putukate püüdmises, eks?
{07 16 00}Kuulsin, et sa oled väga
enesekindel selles, kui
kiiresti sa putukaid püüad{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 14 00}Kuidas oleks, kui seekord
võistleme putuka
harulduses kiiruse asemel?
{07 0b 00}Mis sa ütled,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}? Tahad
proovida?

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Hey, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 05 00} {07 15 00}you should
know just catching any old
bug doesn't prove anything!
{07 19 00}No, a TRUE bug connoisseur
cares {07 14 00}about quality, not
just quantity{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 00 00}If you catch a rarer bug
than I do, {01 00 00 05 00}{07 14 00}then I'll believe
that you're a connoisseur!
{07 0b 00}What do you say?{01 00 00 14 00} Will you
accept my challenge,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Hei, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00},{01 00 00 05 00} {07 15 00}sa peaksid
teadma, et suvalise putuka
püüdmine ei tõesta midagi!
{07 19 00}Ei, TÕELINE putukatundja
hoolib {07 14 00}kvaliteedist, mitte
ainult kogusest{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 00 00}Kui sa püüad haruldasema
putuka kui mina, {01 00 00 05 00}{07 14 00}siis usun,
et sa oled tundja!
{07 0b 00}Mis sa ütled?{01 00 00 14 00} Kas võtad
mu väljakutse vastu,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

messages.en:
{07 00 00}I heard you're also a big
bug fan{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.

{07 0b 00}Did you know that there are
lots of different types of
bug-catching battles?
{07 0e 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Speed matches, {01 00 00 14 00}rarity
matches,{01 00 00 14 00} {04 03 00}
matches{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 00 00}Actually, the {04 03 00}
match is impossible to have
this time of year.
{07 14 00}But we can have a rarity
match! {01 01 00}{07 0b 00}Well? Wanna see who
can catch the rarer bug?
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Ma kuulsin, et sa oled ka
suur putukafänn{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.

{07 0b 00}Kas sa teadsid, et on
palju eri tüüpi
putukapüügi lahinguid?
{07 0e 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Kiirusmatšid, {01 00 00 14 00}harulduse
matšid,{01 00 00 14 00} {04 03 00}
matšid{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 00 00}Tegelikult on {04 03 00}
matši sel aastaajal
võimatu pidada.
{07 14 00}Aga võime pidada harulduse
matši! {01 01 00}{07 0b 00}Noh? Tahad näha, kes
püüab haruldasema putuka?
